run_face_swap: run the Deep Live Cam face swap application with source image, target media, and output path arguments
parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for face swap including source, target, output, execution provider, and thread settings
start_video_processing: start face swap processing on a target video with optional fps, audio, and frame preservation options
decode_execution_providers: decode execution provider strings like cuda, coreml, or rocm into onnxruntime provider names
suggest_execution_threads: suggest optimal execution thread count based on cpu count and selected execution provider
